verdict.rationale: Lambda documents launching instances programmatically through the Lambda Cloud API, whose REST endpoints let you 'create and manage' resources. ODC bills hourly usage in one-minute increments. Community reports show billing applies to any running instance, idle or not, which fits paying for what runs but means you must actively terminate. Missing for 10: documented stop/start (pause) and restart endpoints, first-party documentation of terminate via the API (only an unofficial third-party CLI shows termination), and confirmation that stopped instances incur no charges.
